codes.reason: Pulkovo 1995 / Gauss-Kruger 27N was withdrawn; the zone with the same area of use (Gauss-Kruger CM 159E, Russia 156-162E) is EPSG:2486.
GS-IRF is a live geographic CRS (created 2022 for the Danish Generalstabens System transformation).

IGD05 (3D) was deprecated and replaced by IGD05 (EPSG:7135) per the registry's deprecation record. Its remark names IGD05/12 (later EPSG:7138 via deprecated 6986), so check which Israeli datum is intended.

WGS 84 / Plate Carree was deprecated as a duplicate of the equidistant cylindrical projection. Its registry replacements are EPSG:32663 and EPSG:3786, both deprecated; both chains end at EPSG:4087 (WGS 84 / World Equidistant Cylindrical).
Bogota 1975 / Colombia East was deprecated and replaced by the zoned version Bogota 1975 / Colombia East zone (EPSG:21899) with the same area of use.
